records.text: Unnamed sources reportedly placed Tyler Robinson's surrender around 7 p.m., while the federal 33-hour timeline implied 9 p.m.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #25 (Ep sreYYcID-QY)

appearances.snippet: But then we found out from other sources that actually it was more like seven o'clock p.m. You know, feds are saying 33 hours; that's nine o'clock p.m.
